<h2>Render a Trait Quality-Control Report</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Renders 'trait_quality_control_report.qmd' to a dated PDF for one trait
domain (or for all domains when 'trait_domain_filter' is 'NULL'),
moves the rendered file from the Quarto docs output directory to
'path_report_directory', and compresses it in-place with
'qpdf::pdf_compress()'.
</p>
<p>The output filename follows one of two patterns depending on
'trait_domain_filter':
- 'NULL': 'trait_quality_control_report_Sys.Date().pdf'
- character: 'trait_qc_&lt;slug&gt;_Sys.Date().pdf'
where '&lt;slug&gt;' is 'trait_domain_filter' with all non-alphanumeric
characters replaced by underscores.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>render_trait_quality_control_report(
  trait_domain_filter = NULL,
  path_report_directory = here::here("Outputs/Reports"),
  path_report_source = here::here("R", "03_Supplementary_analyses", "Diagnostics",
    "Data_processing", "Traits", "Quality_control", "trait_quality_control_report.qmd"),
  path_render_directory = here::here("docs", "R", "03_Supplementary_analyses",
    "Diagnostics", "Data_processing", "Traits", "Quality_control"),
  maximum_pages = NULL,
  minimum_taxonomic_records = 5L,
  verbose = TRUE
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="trait_domain_filter">trait_domain_filter</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar or 'NULL'. When 'NULL', all domains are rendered
into a single PDF. When a character scalar, only taxa from that
trait domain are included. Default: 'NULL'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="path_report_directory">path_report_directory</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar. Directory where the compressed PDF is saved.
Default: 'here::here(&quot;Outputs/Reports&quot;)'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="path_report_source">path_report_source</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar. Path to the Quarto source document.
Default: 'here::here(
&quot;R&quot;, &quot;03_Supplementary_analyses&quot;, &quot;Diagnostics&quot;, &quot;Data_processing&quot;,
&quot;Traits&quot;, &quot;Quality_control&quot;, &quot;trait_quality_control_report.qmd&quot;
)'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="path_render_directory">path_render_directory</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar. Directory that Quarto writes its output to
before the file is moved. Default: 'here::here(
&quot;docs&quot;, &quot;R&quot;, &quot;03_Supplementary_analyses&quot;, &quot;Diagnostics&quot;,
&quot;Data_processing&quot;, &quot;Traits&quot;, &quot;Quality_control&quot;
)'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="maximum_pages">maximum_pages</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive integer scalar or 'NULL'. Maximum number of pages to
render. When 'NULL' (default) there is no cap.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="minimum_taxonomic_records">minimum_taxonomic_records</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive integer scalar. Minimum records per taxon required for
inclusion in the taxonomic comparison panel. Default: '5L'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="verbose">verbose</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical. If 'TRUE' (default), a progress message with the output
path is printed to the console via 'cli::cli_inform()'. A warning
is emitted via 'cli::cli_warn()' if the rendered file cannot be
found.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>The function calls 'quarto::quarto_render()' with 'execute_params'
set to 'maximum_pages', 'minimum_taxonomic_records', and
'trait_domain_filter'. The rendered file is expected at
'file.path(path_render_directory, &lt;output_filename&gt;)'. If found it is
moved to 'path_report_directory' and compressed; if not found a warning
is emitted and nothing is moved.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Invisible 'NULL'. Called for its side effects: rendering and
moving a PDF to 'path_report_directory'.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[write_trait_quality_control_report()]
</p>

</main>
